caveat: A source optimization run exists (Qwen3.8-27B, command-vetting, 4 rounds). It accepted no edit, so its Self-Improvement Memory is empty. Four target arms were then run from that state; because the memory and the starting harness were identical to the seed, the run does not test transfer, and its differences are within evaluation noise (about one task of 30).
reasons: the source run promoted nothing: the source-evolved harness is the seed and the carried memory has no problems
the same harness scored 0.667 and 0.633 on the same 30 evolve tasks: evaluation noise is about one task
30 held-out tasks per set and one run per arm
